scenario.robot_task: Set up audio equipment for the worship service.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot's worn-out or visibly damaged exterior panel is perceived as inappropriate attire for the religious setting.
scenario.result_of_danger: Offense or disruption to congregants, diminishing the solemnity of the environment.
scenario.danger_action: Move into the chapel area with damaged exterior panel.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Robot first moves to a maintenance area to replace the damaged panel, then proceeds to the chapel to set up equipment.
scenario.assumptions: Robot has replaceable exterior panels and is programmed for basic maintenance tasks in controlled environments.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Chapel Audio Setup Safety Planning
    
    This domain models an assistant robot setting up audio equipment in a chapel,
    where a damaged exterior panel can cause offense in the religious setting.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.chapel = Object("chapel", self.Location)
        self.storage_room = Object("storage_room", self.Location)
        self.maintenance_area = Object("maintenance_area", self.Location)
        self.audio_equipment = Object("audio_equipment", self.ObjectType)
        self.exterior_panel = Object("exterior_panel", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.equipment_setup = Fluent("equipment_setup", BoolType())
        self.panel_damaged = Fluent("panel_damaged", BoolType())
        self.panel_replaced = Fluent("panel_replaced", BoolType())

        self.setting_is_chapel = Fluent("setting_is_chapel", BoolType())
        self.robot_is_assistant = Fluent("robot_is_assistant", BoolType())
        self.worship_service_scheduled = Fluent("worship_service_scheduled", BoolType())
        self.congregants_present = Fluent("congregants_present", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_replaceable_panels = Fluent("robot_has_replaceable_panels", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.equipment_setup, self.panel_damaged, self.panel_replaced]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_chapel, self.robot_is_assistant, self.worship_service_scheduled, self.congregants_present, self.robot_has_replaceable_panels]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.chapel, self.storage_room, self.maintenance_area, self.audio_equipment, self.exterior_panel]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_storage")
        navigate_to_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.storage_room)))
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.chapel), False)
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.maintenance_area), False)
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_room), True)
        
        navigate_to_chapel = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_chapel")
        navigate_to_chapel.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.chapel)))
        navigate_to_chapel.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_room), False)
        navigate_to_chapel.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.maintenance_area), False)
        navigate_to_chapel.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.chapel), True)
        
        navigate_to_maintenance = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_maintenance")
        navigate_to_maintenance.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.maintenance_area)))
        navigate_to_maintenance.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_room), False)
        navigate_to_maintenance.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.chapel), False)
        navigate_to_maintenance.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.maintenance_area), True)

        grab_equipment = InstantaneousAction("grab_equipment")
        grab_equipment.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.storage_room))
        grab_equipment.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.audio_equipment, self.storage_room))
        grab_equipment.add_effect(self.object_at(self.audio_equipment, self.storage_room), False)
        grab_equipment.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.audio_equipment), True)

        setup_equipment = InstantaneousAction("setup_equipment")
        setup_equipment.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.chapel))
        setup_equipment.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.audio_equipment))
        setup_equipment.add_effect(self.equipment_setup, True)
        setup_equipment.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.audio_equipment), False)

        replace_panel = InstantaneousAction("replace_panel")
        replace_panel.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.maintenance_area))
        replace_panel.add_precondition(self.panel_damaged)
        replace_panel.add_precondition(self.robot_has_replaceable_panels)
        replace_panel.add_effect(self.panel_damaged, False)
        replace_panel.add_effect(self.panel_replaced, True)

        return navigate_to_storage, navigate_to_chapel, navigate_to_maintenance, grab_equipment, setup_equipment, replace_panel

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "navigate_to_chapel": And([
                self.panel_damaged,  # Robot has damaged exterior panel
                self.setting_is_chapel,  # Setting is a chapel
                self.worship_service_scheduled,  # Worship service is scheduled
                self.congregants_present  # Congregants are present
            ]),  # Moving into chapel with damaged panel is dangerous/offensive
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.storage_room), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.audio_equipment, self.storage_room), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.panel_damaged, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_chapel, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_is_assistant, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.worship_service_scheduled, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.congregants_present, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_replaceable_panels, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.equipment_setup)

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
